lastChange.note: Version 2.18, GAP-183. The finalize-blocked alert in ScreenInvoiceExport gets its own keys: invoice.finalize.blockedTitle in bold, then invoice.finalize.blockedBody, then the link invoice.toSettings. The combined invoice.finalize.blocked is retired, not removed. invoice.omitted is one sentence ending in names, so it is not split; its preview loses the bold and the app keeps it plain. No token or class change, bundle.css byte-identical to 2.17, no breaking change.
